Generate the Cypher query to answer the question.
response:
{
  "cypher": "MATCH (d:AircraftModel) 
WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'Dash 7' OR any(alias IN d.aliases WHERE alias CONTAINS 'Dash 7') 
WITH d AS dash7 

MATCH (b:AircraftModel) 
WHERE b.name CONTAINS 'Bell 206' OR any(alias IN b.aliases WHERE alias CONTAINS 'Bell 206') 
WITH dash7, b AS bell206 

RETURN 
  CASE 
    WHEN toFloat(dash7.length_metre) > toFloat(bell206.length_metre) THEN dash7.name 
    WHEN toFloat(dash7.length_metre) < toFloat(bell206.length_metre) THEN bell206.name 
    ELSE 'Both aircraft have the same length' 
  END AS LongerModel, 
  dash7.length_metre AS LengthDash7, 
  bell206.length_metre AS LengthBell206"
  , "rationale": "Finds the AircraftModel instances for Dash 7 and Bell 206 using name or alias matches, converts their length_metre strings to numbers, compares them, and returns the name of the longer model along with both lengths."
}

}
